subject: GROUP

roles.ULT.loc.quote: On 22 November 2019, Roadget Business Pte. Ltd. was established as a private company limited by shares under the laws of Singapore.

roles.ULT.attrs.incorporated_in.quote: established as a private company limited by shares under the laws of Singapore

roles.ULT.attrs.group_revenue_eur.quote: Our net revenues were US$32.1 billion, US$38.7 billion and US$41.8 billion in 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively
roles.ULT.attrs.group_revenue_eur.formula: 2025 US$41.8bn × USD/CNY central parity on 2025-12-31 of 7.0288 ÷ EUR/CNY central parity of 8.2355 (official/fx/cny_central_parity.csv) = EUR35,675,288,689.21; all three years 2023–2025 are far above EUR 750 million, the threshold conclusion is certain

roles.OP.loc.quote: On 30 August 2017, Guangzhou Shein International Import & Export Co., Ltd. was established as a limited liability company under the laws of the PRC.

roles.OP.attrs.incorporated_in.quote: was established as a limited liability company under the laws of the PRC

holds.ULT>OP.ratio.quote: The following diagram illustrates the simplified corporate and shareholding structure of our Group immediately prior to the Global Offering
holds.ULT>OP.ratio.formula: structure chart (pdf 171): Roadget Business Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) holds Guangzhou Shein International Import & Export Co., Ltd. (China) directly by a 100% arrow

flows.up1.foreign_taxed.formula: the dividend is paid to a Singapore company and the Mainland levies withholding tax (Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 3(3), Article 37)

flows.up1.foreign_headline_rate.quote: Our subsidiaries in the Chinese mainland are generally subject to the tax rate of 25% for the periods presented.

flows.up1.deductible_at_payer.formula: a dividend is a distribution of after-tax profit, not deductible by the payer (Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 10(1))

present.HOLD.formula: structure chart (pdf 171): the Singapore company holds the Mainland company directly, with no intermediate holding company in between

present.financing.formula: the structure chart marks it as an equity holding (Equity interests, pdf 171); no intragroup loan disclosed

present.payment.basis: whether the dividend payment crosses years is not disclosed; payment in the same year is taken

event.dividend.quote: Aggregate undistributed earnings of the Group’s subsidiaries in certain jurisdictions that are available for distribution to the Group as of 31 December 2023, 2024, 2025 and 31 March 2026 are US$542, US$846, US$1,223 and US$1,310, respectively.
event.dividend.basis: the Mainland company's dividend to Roadget is not disclosed; US$100m is taken as one dividend (amounts in USD)

company_estimate.quote: Top-up tax under Pillar Two Rules – 1 115 35 4
company_estimate.use: for comparison only: the Pillar Two top-up tax of US$115m recorded by the group for 2025 (not split by jurisdiction; the document says it applies from 2025 in several jurisdictions whose effective tax rate is below 15%); this case gives no Singapore GloBE data, and the program should ask about the Singapore top-up tax rather than fill it in

notes: Source: SHEIN Global Holdings Limited (00625.HK, incorporated in the Cayman Islands) document of 2026-08-24 (cases/sources/K3-shein-2026/source.pdf). K3 semi-synthetic: the chain comes from the structure chart; the dividend amount and date are synthetic values.

Only one segment within the three jurisdictions is modelled: Roadget Business Pte. Ltd. (Singapore, the group's main operating and investment holding company) is ULT, Guangzhou Shein International Import & Export Co., Ltd. (Mainland) is OP; the Cayman listed company and the BVI intermediate companies are out of scope.

The Singapore company enjoys the Development and Expansion Incentive (qualifying income at 5%) and the finance and treasury centre incentive (8%) (pdf 227) — these cover qualifying income only and dividends are not taxed at those rates, so cit_rate is not written; Singapore's GloBE income, covered taxes, payroll and tangible assets are not disclosed by jurisdiction, left for the program to ask.

names: each party's defined term / full name in the document (aliases separated by /), individuals written as in the document, used for locating extraction patterns, search queries and registry look-ups (抽取改造.md §2, §7)
